blurb: Welcome to Coto Equestrian Preserve, 24.1 acres of land dedicated to the equestrian sporting life. Located in Coto de Caza, Coto Equestrian Preserve boards approximately 150 horses and boasts 6 riding arenas including an Indoor Ring, Grand Prix Arena and Dressage
